text:
Nina (product): Quick brainstorm: building an 'Invocation Lens' card for the Cost Dashboard. Goal: let teams scan per-invocation unit economics (model, tokens, cache crediting) and run a 'what-if' toggle to see impact if caching was off. Need an API + telemetry contract.
Ravi (eng): Love it. Two quick asks: 1) we need a stable key for any prefetch/slab so we can attribute amortized credits later, 2) keep tile payload tiny (no full prompts unless requested).
Luca (platform): We currently emit token_counts and an opaque cache_flag. For amortization we'd need slab_key and slab_scope in telemetry (e.g., slab_scope: tenant/shared). Also many chains hit multiple models; we should attach a model_chain array or a top_model field.
Pri (design): UI: small stacked bar + a pill showing "cache credit" and a popover with details. The popover can lazy-load a full trace. We should make the card default to a summarized pre-agg view for performance.
costbot: Note: full-trace retention is limited; we sample full traces at 0.5% in prod. Turning to 1% would ~x8 storage and increase query p99.
Nina (product): Proposed API: GET /v2/econ/invocations/summary?start=...&end=...&expand=trace,slab&sample_pct=0.5
Nina (product): example curl + minimal summary response:
```bash
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v2/econ/invocations/summary?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-07&expand=slab" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
```json
[
  {
    "invocation_id": "inv_8a3f...",
    "ts": "2026-03-05T09:12:33Z",
    "top_model": "redwood-v2-1B",
    "model_chain": ["redwood-v2-1B","redwood-v2-3B-fallback"],
    "tokens": {"prompt": "24","completion": "120","cached": "16"},
    "cache_credit_usd": "0.0011",
    "cost_usd": "0.0045",
    "slab_key": "slab_20260305_42",
    "slab_scope": "shared",
    "simulate_no_cache_cost_usd": "0.0056"
  }
]
```
Ravi (eng): That payload is reasonable. Implementation notes: computing simulate_no_cache requires pre-aggregates of avoided_tokens by slab and joining to invocations for the window. Doing that on-the-fly for large windows is expensive.
Luca (platform): Suggest we maintain an hourly pre-agg table: (slab_key, hour_ts, avoided_tokens, sample_count) and a separate per-invocation sampled store for trace expand. The summary endpoint can compute cache_credit_usd by joining to the hourly table and amortizing based on slab_scope.
Pri (design): UX detail: the "amortize by" toggle (tenant / global / custom) should be available. If custom, UI will surface the formula used. Also we want a small "confidence" badge when data is sampled.
costbot: Caution: adding slab_key to every invocation increases cardinality of metrics vector. Consider limiting slab_key population to invocations that actually touch prefetch.
Nina (product): For multi-model chains, we should show which model actually produced tokens (token attribution). Is router able to tag per-stage token attribution?
Ravi (eng): Router today knows chosen endpoints and can attach chosen_variant and stage_id. We need to plumb stage_token_counts into telemetry; that means small proto change and a short-term perf test.
Luca (platform): I'll propose adding fields: stage_token_counts[], slab_key (optional), slab_scope (optional), chosen_variant_id. We'll roll that change behind a flag for canary.
Pri (design): Also ask for an endpoint-level rate limit: expand=trace should be throttled and cost-metered separately so dashboards don't overwhelm the backend. Maybe a points system (expand=trace costs 10 points per trace).
Ravi (eng): Agreed. We'll add a quota for econ endpoints and a per-caller rate cap. Also implement a page-size default of 200 and cursor-based pagination.
Nina (product): Action items: 1) Luca: RFC for telemetry proto + slab_key rollout (ETA 2d). 2) Ravi: prototype hourly pre-agg job for avoided_tokens (ETA 1 week). 3) Pri: final mocks + confidence/computed-formula copy (ETA 3d). 4) Nina: write endpoint spec and include sample SQL for amortization (ETA 3d).
Luca (platform): I'll post the RFC in #eng-platform and tag @ravi for review. I'll add a migration plan: populate slab_key when invocation touches prefetch; stay optional otherwise.
Pri (design): I'll add the simulate-no-cache delta UI and a tooltip explaining the amortization assumptions.
Ravi (eng): Quick perf note: try pre-agg at 5min buckets for high-traffic slabs and hourly for everything else. That keeps the tile responsive for hot tenants.
Nina (product): Let's aim for an alpha with 0.5% sampled traces + pre-agg tile in two sprints. If sampling or cost is an issue, we can lower sample_pct.
costbot: FYI: turning on slab_key will increase cardinality; ops costing estimate pending.
Nina (product): Thanks all. I'll collect the mock, RFC links, and the endpoint spec in this thread when ready. :rocket:
